Creating a Threads

How we make her Threads, from her Instagram. Watch the videos first, then follow this step by step, every time.

Version v0.1Updated 10 Nov 2026Owner KTool Threads app · Samsung
Download PDF

01Watch first

How to create a Threads account. Watch it once for the flow.

Video not playing? Open it here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PegiNI_-Ulk

Threads profiling example (Loom). Watch all of it before you start. Come back to it any time.

tutorial link

02What this is

Threads runs on her Instagram: you log in with it, and it copies her profile across. On Threads, pictures matter the most, in posts and in replies. Make the Instagram first.

⚠ The rules that get accounts banned

NEVER CONNECT THE PHONE TO WI-FI. HOTSPOT ONLY.

NEVER DOWNLOAD A PICTURE FROM GOOGLE DRIVE ONTO THE PHONE. ALWAYS OPEN IT AND TAKE A SCREENSHOT.

The apps can see where a picture came from and how the phone connects. Break one of these and the account gets banned.

03Before you start

  • Her Instagram is made, on this phone (SOP: Creating an Instagram).
  • The phone is on a hotspot.
  • Her pictures are ready (SOP: Creating Pictures).

04Step by step

1

Open Threads

Open the Threads app (installed when the phone was set up). Not there? Play Store → Threads → Open.

2

Log in with Instagram

At the bottom it shows her Instagram. Press Log in with Instagram.

3

Check it is her account

If it shows a list, pick her Instagram. Not there? Log in to another Instagram account with her username and password from the sheet.

Wrong account = the wrong model on Threads. Check the name.

4

Import from Instagram

Profile: press Import from Instagram. Her name, bio and picture come across.

Examples · tap to open
anything different on Threads from Instagram?
5

Check the profile

Name, bio and picture are hers. Press Next.

6

Privacy: public

Choose Public profile. Next.

Why: a private profile can't be found. Fans have to see her.

7

Follow the same accounts: no

Don't press Follow all. Press Next at the top right.

or follow all?
8

Join Threads

Press Join Threads. You're in.

9

Hide AI comments

Do this the moment the account exists. Before anything gets posted.

Fans who find her have to feel she is real. One "this is AI" comment under a post and everyone who reads it starts to wonder. So the account hides those comments before anyone sees them.

Where: Profile → ☰ → Privacy → Hidden Words → Manage custom words and phrases.

Paste this list in, then turn Hide comments ON:

ai, a.i, a.i., fake, deepfake, bot, scam, gpt, chatgpt, slop, faked, not real, midjourney
Screenshot · th-hw · Hidden Words on Threads
10

Upload at highest quality: ON

Turn this on now, before the first post. It’s off by default.

Where: Profile → ☰ → Account → Media quality → Upload at highest quality: on.

Why: with it off, Threads squashes every picture and video when it uploads. Her posts come out blurry next to the real girls’ posts. This is why quality dropped before.

11

Day 1: nothing posted yet

Look around the feed for a few minutes like a person would. Threads first posts and warm up

12

Into the login sheet

Threads uses the Instagram login. Mark Threads as made, next to it in the sheet.

05What it should look like

Screenshot · th-good · a finished Threads profile

Threads example from K

06Done means

  • Threads made from her Instagram.
  • Profile picture, name and bio in.
  • First posts up.
  • Hidden Words in, Hide comments on.
  • Upload at highest quality on.
  • Marked in the company login sheet.

07Common mistakes

  • Making Threads before Instagram.
  • An empty profile.

Added after every review with K
